  const legacyPath = process.env.NEXTGO_OFFLINE_LEGACY_ARTIFACTS;
  if (!legacyPath) throw new Error('NEXTGO_OFFLINE_LEGACY_ARTIFACTS must pin actual pre-recovery 46bf production artifacts; no synthetic legacy worker or skip is permitted');
  const legacy = await readOfflineArtifacts(legacyPath);
  expect([shelf.artifacts.A.binarySHA256, shelf.artifacts.B.binarySHA256]).not.toContain(legacy.A.binarySHA256);
  // Stop the original server owner before creating the explicitly owned mixed
  // generation fixture on the same fixed public origin. Its finalizer remains
  // harmless and the mixed owner is joined separately below.
  await shelf.stopNetwork();
  const mixed = await startOfflineFixture({...legacy, B: shelf.artifacts.B});
  let page, proof, before, after, oldRuntime, newRuntime;
  try {
    page = await shelf.open(); await enable(mixed, page);
    oldRuntime = await page.locator('body').getAttribute('data-nextgo-build');
    const controllerBefore = await page.evaluate(() => {globalThis.legacyRecoveryController = navigator.serviceWorker.controller; return {scriptURL: legacyRecoveryController.scriptURL, state: legacyRecoveryController.state};});
    await mixed.select('B'); await page.reload(); await ready(page);
    newRuntime = await page.locator('body').getAttribute('data-nextgo-build'); expect(newRuntime).not.toBe(oldRuntime);
    // A native reload is still controlled by the old active generation; no
    // update/activation request has been issued by this compatibility witness.
    const statusCompletion = await nextOfflineCompletion(page); await page.locator('[data-offline-status-button]').click();
    await expect(controls(page)).toHaveAttribute('data-offline-completed-operations', statusCompletion);
    await expect(controls(page)).toHaveAttribute('data-offline-enabled', 'true');
    before = await ownedAccounting(page);
    await parentEmptyDisableFault(page);
    let primaryFailed = false;
    try {
      const completion = await nextOfflineCompletion(page); await page.locator('[data-offline-disable]').click();
      await expect(controls(page)).toHaveAttribute('data-offline-completed-operations', completion);
      await expect(controls(page)).not.toHaveAttribute('data-offline-operation-error', '');
      await expect(controls(page)).toHaveAttribute('data-offline-enabled', 'true');
      await expect(controls(page)).toHaveAttribute('data-offline-cleanup-pending', 'false');
    } catch (error) {primaryFailed = true; throw error;}
    finally {proof = await finishDisableWitness(page, info, primaryFailed);}
    assertDisableWitness(proof, {dispatched: 1, unregister: 0});
    const ack = proof.observation.disableRecovered.ack;
    expect(ack).toMatchObject({enabled: false, error: 'unsupported-command', runtimeID: oldRuntime});
    after = await ownedAccounting(page); expect(after.generations).toEqual(before.generations); expect(after.index.disabled).toBe(false);
    const native = await page.evaluate(async () => {const registration = await navigator.serviceWorker.getRegistration(); return {active: registration.active?.state, waiting: registration.waiting?.state || null, controller: navigator.serviceWorker.controller?.state, scriptURL: navigator.serviceWorker.controller?.scriptURL};});
    expect(native.active).toBe('activated'); expect(native.controller).toBe('activated'); expect(native.scriptURL).toBe(controllerBefore.scriptURL);
    expect([null, 'installed']).toContain(native.waiting);
    await info.attach('recovered-disable-genuine-legacy-worker-refusal', {body: JSON.stringify({legacyArtifact: legacy.A, currentArtifact: shelf.artifacts.B,
      requiredLegacySource: '46bf41a35b5db96f81927c6f138ca1a8e36e2d6d', oldRuntime, newRuntime, proof, native, before, after,
      meaning: 'One actual unsupported recovery command, COMPLETE typed-branch coverage, and zero actual unregister/update/register dispatch receipts. Native browser soft-update scheduling is not counted as a Go dispatch; an old active worker remains the actual status/control target.'}), contentType: 'application/json'});
  } finally {
    const closeErrors = [];
    try {await shelf.closeBrowser();} catch (error) {closeErrors.push(error);}
    try {await mixed.close();} catch (error) {closeErrors.push(error);}
    const joined = mixed.snapshot();
    expect(joined.nativePID).toBe(null); expect(joined.gatewayListening).toBe(false); expect(joined.processes.every(value => value.exited)).toBe(true);
    await info.attach('recovered-disable-mixed-fixture-joined', {body: JSON.stringify(joined), contentType: 'application/json'});
    if (closeErrors.length) throw new AggregateError(closeErrors, 'Mixed-release browser/server ownership could not be joined');
  }
});
